description: This file defines the IdentifierAndCteSubstitutor class responsible for substituting CTE references and unresolved identifiers in logical plans within Spark SQL's analysis phase. It handles CTE resolution, plan traversal, and expression transformation.

classes.name: IdentifierAndCteSubstitutor
classes.description: Class responsible for substituting CTE references and unresolved identifiers in logical plans, managing CTE scope, and transforming plan nodes and expressions.

methods.name: substitutePlan
methods.description: Main entry point for plan substitution; resets CTE registry and initiates recursive substitution.

methods.name: substitute
methods.description: Recursively processes logical plan nodes, handling WITH clauses, unresolved relations, and other operators.

methods.name: handleWith
methods.description: Processes WITH clauses, registers CTEs, and substitutes within the CTE plan and child plan.

methods.name: handleUnresolvedRelation
methods.description: Replaces unresolved relation with a CTE reference if applicable.

methods.name: handleOperator
methods.description: Handles generic logical plan operators, recursing into children and subqueries, applying CTE scope management.
